result.description: Customer service platform (people-centered helpdesk) unifying voice, SMS, email, chat and social conversations around a customer profile.
result.auth_detail: Basic auth: username = agent email, password = API token. Token created by a user with the API User permission (More settings > API Tokens). No OAuth documented. Token is tied to one org/environment and has unrestricted access.
result.access_detail: Tokens exist only inside an existing paying Gladly org; an admin must grant a user the API User permission. No public signup or free trial. Sandbox (*.gladly.qa) must be bought/requested via the CSM or support. Request-demo is the only entry.
result.api_notes: REST v1 at https://{org}.gladly.com/api/v1. Resources: agents, answers, business hours, communications (SMS/email), conversations (items, notes, replies, topics, redact), customers, tasks, topics, inboxes, teams, events, export, reports, proactive conversations, webhooks, user identity JWT, organization. Plus Lookup API and webhooks.
result.blocker: No self-serve signup or free sandbox. Credentials only exist inside a customer account; sandbox is a paid add-on arranged via Gladly CSM/support. Need a design-partner account or sandbox from Gladly.

evidence.quote: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication. API tokens are associated with designated Gladly users.
To create and use an API token, your user must have the API User permission.
Clients can access the REST API via HTTPS at your organization's Gladly domain (e.g. https://{organization}.gladly.com).
We'll enable the Gladly API in a separate sandbox environment
contact your Gladly CSM or support team
